newsitem.title: USA: Va. Housing Development taxable issue 5.45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Va. Housing Development taxable issue 5.45 pct.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it priced a $190 million Virginia Housing Development Authority taxable weekly variable rate bond issue with a 5.45 percent coupon.
A 1996 Series E $140 million taxable portion was priced at par with a 5.45 percent coupon and dated 12/18/1996 and due 1/1/2046.
A $50 million taxable 1996 Series F portion was priced at par with a 5.45 percent coupon and dated 12/18/1996 and due 1/1/2034.
